fullPassage: Piaget put the same amount of water into two different glasses: a tall narrow glass and a wide glass, then asked kids to compare two glasses. Kids younger than six or seven usually say that the tall narrow glass now holds more water, because the level is higher. And when they are ready, they figure out the conservation of volume for themselves just by playing with cups of water. Rather, it is self-constructed as kids play with other kids. Taking turns in a game is like pouring water back and forth between glasses. Once kids have reached the age of five or six, then playing games and working things out together will help them learn about fairness far more effectively than any teaching from adults.

det.analysis:
✅ ① younger: Kids younger than six or seven — than을 동반한 비교급으로 올바른 어법
✅ ② holds: the tall narrow glass holds — 3인칭 단수 현재형으로 올바른 어법
❌ ③ by themselves → for themselves: figure out ~ for themselves는 '스스로 알아내다'의 관용 표현. by themselves는 '혼자서(외롭게)'의 의미로 문맥에 맞지 않음
✅ ④ effectively: working things out together will help them learn ~ far more effectively — 비교급을 수식하는 부사로 올바른 어법
det.tip: for oneself(스스로, 직접)와 by oneself(혼자서, 홀로)의 의미 차이를 구분하세요.
